name: tolu-cv-game
description: A 3D driving CV game — pilot a ROVA garbage truck through a green world and drive through glowing portals into chapters of Toluwalase Awobusuyi's CV.

scripts.optimize:truck: gltf-transform dedup assets-src/rova-truck.source.glb /tmp/_t1.glb && gltf-transform weld /tmp/_t1.glb /tmp/_t2.glb && gltf-transform prune /tmp/_t2.glb /tmp/_t3.glb && gltf-transform meshopt /tmp/_t3.glb public/rova-truck.glb
